name: The Weather Forecast
summary: Product health as a Doppler weather map: one storm cell blooms over Checkout, a human forecaster calls it, and the film ends in clear skies.
look: A night-blue TV-weather studio and a dark Doppler scope with teal range rings and a conic sweep. Blurred teal→amber→coral cells mark metric trouble; the CTA flips to a pale morning sky with an amber sun.

components.name: Five-day card
components.role: TV-weather strip that stages the hook

components.name: Radar scope
components.role: rings = minutes until customers feel it; sectors = metrics

components.name: Conic sweep
components.role: gradient beam with a fading trailing edge; the agent's heartbeat

components.name: Storm cell
components.role: blurred blobs; only one reaches coral

components.name: Datablock
components.role: mono readout tethered to the cell with the anomaly text

motion.name: Sweep
motion.how: @property angle 0→360° over 3.2 s, linear; each turn starts on a bar line at 120 BPM

motion.name: Cell ignition
motion.how: delay = angle ÷ 360 × 3.2 s so cells light as the beam hits; fade 95%→12% over 1.5 s

motion.name: Storm clears
motion.how: resolved cells shrink and desaturate, 0.08 s stagger, power2.in, on the downbeat after the decision

story: Hook: a five-day card of fog, Friday turns into a storm and the ticker says the warning came too late. Reveal: the card collapses into the scope centre and the first sweep lights 'Acme Pulse' on the drop. Proof: the beam sweeps metric sectors; a cell over Checkout goes coral, the datablock reads '−18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231', and the forecaster taps Roll back before customers are affected. CTA: morning sky, 'Caught before customers noticed.', 'FRI · CLEAR · resolved in 6 min', Start free.
adapt: Name the sectors after your own signals (queues, regions, customers, spend) and let the rings mean your own 'time until it hurts'.

references.note: CSS conic radar sweep with cells timed to the beam

fit.risk: Storms read as bad news and a busy scope is hard at 1:1; cap it at five sectors, resolve fast, end in sunshine.
